text: 英国商业、创新、科学和贸易大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹驳斥了欧盟要求英国对中国商品加征关税的主张。他表示，英国政府不会因布鲁塞尔的压力而改变贸易规则。
text_en: UK Secretary of State for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Jonathan Reynolds rejected the EU's call for the UK to impose tariffs on Chinese goods. He said the UK government will not change its trade rules under pressure from Brussels.
